documents.title: CSE Generative AI Usage Policy
documents.summary: A department-wide policy for a teaching-focused regional private university that actively encourages students to use generative AI for coding, debugging, ideation and learning, framed by analogy to pair programming and tutoring. It requires an AI-use statement (with an IEEE-style citation example) on all work and asks students to flag portions done without AI, while stressing that AI should complement rather than replace personal learning.
